## Checklist

- [ ] I checked [Inkipedia](https://splatoonwiki.org) first: this is strategy/know-how, not game data (stats, enemy/item lists, story, patch notes).
- [ ] Weapons, gadgets, enemies and mechanics link to their Inkipedia page instead of restating stats.
- [ ] Every tip, video or idea from someone else is credited and linked.
- [ ] Screenshots are in `docs/assets/screenshots/`, named `YYYY-MM-DD-author.png`.
- [ ] No datamined files or ripped game assets.
